All seven refinements are in. Here's a summary of exactly what I changed.

## Spec updated — refinements applied

| Your point | Where it landed |
|---|---|
| **Notes support simple Markdown, shown formatted** | US2 story + scenario 2; FR-006; Bookmark entity |
| **Title & description editable while saving *and* after** | US1 story + scenarios 3–4; FR-004 |
| **List items show title, description, tags, site icon** | US1 scenario 5; new FR-004a |
| **Plain text + `#tag` together → both must match (unless `OR`)** | US4 story + new scenario 5; new FR-010a |
| **Operators in quotes → searched as literal text** | US4 story + new scenario 7; new FR-010b |
| **Tag names unique even when typed, not chosen** | US5 scenario 4; new FR-014a |
| **Local copy = self-contained single file, opens offline** | US12 scenario 1; FR-021; Page Copy entity |

I also renumbered the US4 search scenarios (now 10, including explicit `OR` and boolean/grouping examples) so each behavior has its own acceptance example.

The full spec is at `specs/001-bookmark-manager/spec.md`. All quality-checklist items still pass and there are no open clarifications.
